postal_system.assignment_rule: Posta Shqiptare postcode pages establish a four-digit post-office or branch assignment. UPU format guidance and four-digit syntax do not establish a current allocation.
postal_system.perimeter_rule: No nationwide official postcode-polygon source is assumed. A surface is derived only from rights-cleared, versioned official address membership and compatible boundaries and remains explicitly derived.
postal_system.address_rule: The National Address System supplies official address and address-building context through ASIG-published services. Service visibility is not treated as a bulk redistribution license.
postal_system.building_rule: Exact building display requires the same official address or cadastral object identifier, or a reviewed explicit crosswalk. Address points, parcels, containment, and proximity remain candidates.
postal_system.administrative_rule: ASIG administrative geometry supplies jurisdiction and clipping context but never creates postal membership.
postal_system.territory_rule: Postal assignment never determines sovereignty or a legal boundary. Albania and Kosovo remain separate country packs, and no neighboring feature receives AL identity from language, proximity, or routing evidence.

temporal_model.valid_time: Postal, address, cadastral, building, and boundary validity when supplied by the source.
temporal_model.known_time: Source publication, capture, ingest, correction, and release timestamps retained independently.
temporal_model.history_rule: Later postal or registry evidence appends a versioned assertion and never silently rewrites an earlier release.

quality_gates.pass: Each postcode assignment references a pinned Posta Shqiptare page or permitted release and retains office or branch class, locality, capture time, rights, and digest.
Every derived surface retains member addresses, algorithm, parameters, boundary clips, validation metrics, source releases, rights, and digest and is never labelled official.
Each address assertion retains its official object identifier, hierarchy, status, coordinate provenance, release, and permitted public fields.
An exact building has the same official address/cadastral object identifier or a reviewed explicit crosswalk; spatial proximity is candidate-only.
Each ASIG/ASHK layer retains coverage and vintage; no unsourced gap is filled and no neighboring-country feature receives AL identity.
No recipient, resident, owner, tenant, occupant, phone, credential, title, civil-status, or protected cadastral field is published.
Synthetic fixtures verify behavior but never satisfy production evidence gates.

stages.definition: Source roles, rights, coverage, and blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.
Pinned rights-cleared snapshots reproduce experimental packs with complete lineage.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
